# ChannelBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelBus:Void channel:Int32, bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) or [EmitSound](EmitSound). |
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Moves a channel to a bus. It is heard there from the next block of sound on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelBus](GetChannelBus) tells the bus of a channel, and [SoundBus](SoundBus) picks the bus that channels start on.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
ch = PlaySound(door)
ChannelBus ch, world
```
